$comment: 緋夢樂園（docs/LUST_PARK.md）的背景圖：key 就是 src/assets/backgrounds/ 的檔名（見那裡的 README.md）。tags 是給 ComfyUI 與 NovelAI 的 Danbooru 標籤，adult 是成人向的加料（--safe 時不加）；text 是給 ChatGPT（OpenAI 圖片 API）的句子，不含成人內容。共用畫風見 style。

style.tags_prefix: masterpiece, best quality, scenery, no humans, fantasy, concept art, painterly, oil painting (medium), wide shot, detailed background, depth of field,
style.tags_suffix: , subject on one side, low contrast center, cinematic lighting
style.negative: humans, people, 1girl, 1boy, character, text, watermark, signature, username, logo, frame, border, ui, lowres, blurry, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, bad perspective
style.text_prefix: Epic dark fantasy concept art painted with light oil-painting brushwork, a wide 16:9 landscape background for a video game.
style.text_suffix: The main subject sits off to one side and the center of the image stays calm and low in contrast so interface panels can sit on top. No people, no characters, no text, no logos.
